entry.title: KutilXXL 0.3.3
entry.summary: KutilXXL for Force / MPC OS by L'Cronx: a groovebox of Bastl-style modules patched with touch cables. Install: unzip, run install.sh (INSTALL.md inside), or use the MPC plugin installer. Tested offline only; not yet tested on a Force.
